highlight.note: The graph is drawn from the organisation as it is now; while it loads, a skeleton says “Drawing the organisation”.
The key lists the kinds of line drawn — Holds, Works on, Reports to — and when the graph was made.
Left to right: the organisation, its divisions, projects and apps; then the people and contractors working on them, and secrets by name.
Each card says what it is — Division, App, Employee — and “working” while it works.
On a wide screen, hovering a line names it: “Kasper works on Court booking”.
On a wide screen the drawing is dragged to move around; the page never scrolls sideways.
